content:
**S'mores** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

A delicious campfire treat which consists of toasted marshmallow and melted chocolate, sandwiched between two crackers. A favorite of the Pioneer Scouts.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Bone (1) Brahmin Milk (1) Razorgrain Flour (2) Spices (1) Sugar (2) Syrup (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: S'mores | | S'mores (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station after having learned the Recipe.
